copy.heading: Recruitment Ban
copy.subheading: Leave them alone, Josh. They're fine as they are.
body: Since taking up padel you have tried to recruit your father, your father-in-law, your boss, two neighbours, the boiler man, the new graduate and a man who was only trying to sell you a car. Some of them have given it a go. Most of them are now avoiding you. This phase introduces a temporary recruitment ban and helps you through it.

illustration.concept: Josh leaning over a garden fence holding out a spare racket to his older neighbour, who is backing away with a watering can, while in the background a man in a boiler-repair van pretends to be on the phone and Graham, older and holding a walking stick, peers through a front window.
